public_rationale: The deadline is December 31, 2026. No retrieved evidence conclusively settles the complete forecast early. Microsoft has disclosed an AI run rate and realized revenue from OpenAI arrangements, which limits any broad nondisclosure claim. Those measures do not unambiguously match the own-product reading in context. A complete LLM-specific investment total is also missing, and the claim's accounting basis is unspecified.
limitations: Total hyperscaler capex cannot be substituted for LLM investment.
Nondisclosure alone cannot establish that revenue is inadequate.
An unknown accounting basis prevents a supported or contradicted monetary verdict.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: By end of 2026 hyperscalers will have invested over $1.5 trillion in LLMs, which have not produced revenue worth disclosing.
public_payload.original_horizon_text: by the end of the year

statement.excerpt: Hyperscalers will, by the end of the year, have sunk over $1.5 trillion in capital expenditures and equity investments into Large Language Models that have yet to provide good enough revenues to actually disclose.
statement.document_title: The More You Buy, The More You Lose

from_speaker: by the end of the year
have yet to provide good enough revenues to actually disclose
our_interpretation: The deadline is December 31, 2026. 'Have sunk' means cumulative investment actually made, rather than announced future commitments.
The surrounding discussion identifies Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon and Meta. Inclusion of other hyperscalers is unspecified.
Only spending attributable to LLMs counts. Total corporate capital expenditure cannot automatically be treated as LLM investment.
The surrounding discussion makes separately disclosed realized AI revenue the ordinary test of the disclosure clause. An annualized run rate is a different measure.
The words do not establish that nondisclosure is caused by inadequate revenue. That explanation requires evidence beyond the absence of a disclosure.
criteria.support_condition: By December 31, 2026, a reconciled, nonduplicative total of realized LLM capital expenditure and equity investment exceeds $1.5 trillion for the relevant companies, and the claimed absence of separately disclosed realized AI revenue holds.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A complete, comparable year-end accounting establishes cumulative investment of $1.5 trillion or less, or a clearly matching realized AI revenue disclosure falsifies the nondisclosure clause. Neither ordinary cloud revenue nor an annualized run rate alone settles the latter.
